ActionName.description: Every governed command a section can offer. Closed.
ActionName.title: ActionName

ActionView.description:
One action as the server judged it: available (`refusal` null) or refused
with the code the command would answer. Advisory; the command rechecks.
ActionView.title: ActionView

AddToBook.description:
Add a COMPLETE run with CP-1 accepted to the Book (spec B3, B5): the
snapshot digest of the accepted artifacts the actor reviewed (invariant
5) and the analyst-stated classification. The subject, the metrics, the
adder and the time are the host's, never fields.
AddToBook.title: AddToBook

BlockedByView.description:
The node whose validated Blocked verdict ended the run, and the attempt
that answered it.

Recorded by the transition that ended the run, from the verdict the runtime
had just re-derived (`block_run`, §68) -- never re-derived here. The answer
is an unaccepted attempt's stored body, and the store refuses to judge it
again once the run is no longer RUNNING (`check_attempt`), so a reader that
tried would be refused; and a replay later would rest on evidence and a
bundle that may since have moved. The node's own `state` stays RUNNABLE,
because a Blocked verdict accepts nothing: without this a document could
only say the node did not run, which is the opposite of what happened.
BlockedByView.title: BlockedByView

BlockedQuoteView.description:
One quote of a Blocked answer the host located (D106): the document,
page and quote, compact in the view, and the line it is an excerpt of,
which the source drawer shows with the excerpt marked (D105, D107). No
rectangle is served: a Blocked answer is no accepted record.
BlockedQuoteView.title: BlockedQuoteView

BookBody.description:
The desk-wide Book (spec B2, B15): every issuer with a live entry,
and the metrics the column chooser offers. The client filters and
sorts.
BookBody.title: BookBody

BookDocument.description: Portfolio-scoped: no case in its path, so `chrome.subject` is null.
BookDocument.title: BookDocument

BookEntryAdded.description: The receipt for an added entry.
BookEntryAdded.title: BookEntryAdded

BookEntryView.description:
One book entry as stored (spec B10): the run's pinned subject, the
analyst-stated classification and its composite (spec B6), and the
metrics on each basis as the Add to Book command stored them.
`fiscal_years` names a projected basis' fiscal year, kept out of
`metrics` so every figure there is decimal text or null.
`snapshot_sha256` is the entry's stored digest, which Withdraw is bound
to. `filed` says the run's deliverable is filed (spec B4);
`sources_withdrawn` that a source pinned to the run is no longer live
(spec B8).
BookEntryView.title: BookEntryView

BookEntryWithdrawn.description: The receipt for a withdrawn entry.
BookEntryWithdrawn.title: BookEntryWithdrawn

BookIssuerView.description:
One issuer's row (spec B1, B4): its newest live entry, and every
other entry it has, withdrawn ones included, newest first.
BookIssuerView.title: BookIssuerView

BookMetricView.description:
A metric the Book's column chooser offers: one of the Model's own
book lines (`caos.api.reads.model.book_catalogue`), in the Model's
order.
BookMetricView.title: BookMetricView

CaseRow.description:
One case the actor holds live standing on.

`members` is served only to the case's ADMIN, who is the one member that
may change it; `null` says the list was not served, not that it is empty.
`actions` judges the two membership commands for this case alone.
CaseRow.title: CaseRow

CellView.description:
One cell: its exact text and, where the bundle's `parse_figure` reads a
figure, that figure's exact value -- `Decimal` in plain notation, never a
float (invariant 7). `None` is no figure, which is never zero.
CellView.title: CellView

Chrome.description: The authority facts the client composes its chrome from.
Chrome.title: Chrome

CitationView.description:
A host-verified citation; withdrawal is read live. `source_id` is the
pinned source the document resolves to, which addresses its page (4.4).
`page` is where the quote is; `cited_page` is the other page the module
named when the host re-anchored the quote there (D94), else null. `line`
is the evidence line the quote is an excerpt of (D105), where the record
holds it. `linked` is false for a quote the answer's body does not carry
(D106): still host-verified, but "not linked to a statement in the
answer". `marker` is the `[C<n>]` the body cites it by (D107), which the
workspace draws as a chip opening this citation.
CitationView.title: CitationView

DeliverableFiled.description:
The filing's own receipt. The detached one -- renderer and filing link --
is derived from the audit event this unit writes, so it is read from the
Committee section rather than answered here.
DeliverableFiled.title: DeliverableFiled

EdgeView.description: One dependency a node is still waiting for, with its type.
EdgeView.title: EdgeView

FrameView.description: A page's frame in the coordinates its rectangles are stored in.
FrameView.title: FrameView

Gate.description: The digest-bound interrupts a run can wait on.
Gate.title: Gate

GatePreviewDocument.description: The exact content an approver is shown, and the digests to submit.
GatePreviewDocument.title: GatePreviewDocument

GateState.description: Whether the run may pass, judged against the content that is there now.
GateState.title: GateState

GlobalRole.description: What kind of account this is. Not what it may do to a given case.
GlobalRole.title: GlobalRole

GrantStanding.description:
Give or replace one member's standing. The member is named; the actor
granting it is derived, and holds ADMIN on the case.
GrantStanding.title: GrantStanding

LineView.description:
The evidence line a citation anchored in, split around its excerpt
(D105), and whether the record holds that line at all (`recorded`).

Recorded, `before + excerpt + after` is the line: an `EXCERPT` record's
`line_text`, or, under either whole-line rule, the quote, which is its
line (`before` and `after` empty). An excerpt is never shown without its
line, so a qualifier just outside it ("not", "provided that", a row's
label) is the reader's to see (AI-4). `excerpt` is the line's own text of
the quote, empty where the host cannot place it (the line is then shown
whole and unmarked). Not recorded -- an `ANY_RUN` record, whose quote is
any unique run of its page -- `excerpt` is the quote alone, which is no
source line and is shown as a quote, never as one.
LineView.title: LineView

MemberRow.description: One live member of a case, as its administrator is shown it.
MemberRow.title: MemberRow

ModelBody.description:
The credit model of the displayed run's accepted CP-1, with CP-2G and
CP-CF's projections where the route ran them, or empty before CP-1 is
accepted (spec M1). `forecast` is the accepted CP-CF record, kept for
comparison. Every line has exactly one cell per column.
ModelBody.title: ModelBody

ModelCellView.description:
One cell: an exact decimal string, or the reason it has none (never
both); how it was reached; CP-1's own figure where the host recomputed
one; the cell's note; and the rows it came from, at most
`MODEL_SOURCES_MAX`.
ModelCellView.title: ModelCellView

ModelChoice.description:
A model the deployment approves for a new run (`CAOS_MODEL_CHOICES`),
at the dated price a run started on it is pinned to (F468). `configured`
marks the deployment's own model, the one a `CreateRun` naming none gets.
Rates are per token, in plain notation (invariant 7).
ModelChoice.title: ModelChoice

ModelColumnView.description:
One column: a reported, derived or projected period. `column_id` is
opaque; a reader uses the other fields.
ModelColumnView.title: ModelColumnView

ModelLineView.description: One line of the model, in its band, with one cell per column.
ModelLineView.title: ModelLineView

ModelSourceView.description:
A CP-1 row a cell's figure came from: its own source id and locator,
and the CP-1 citation its `[C<n>]` marker names (D107), else null.
ModelSourceView.title: ModelSourceView

ModelTermsView.description: A facility's rate terms as the layout states them.
ModelTermsView.title: ModelTermsView

ModelUnit.description:
A projected value's own dimension (R24-12): the calculator's `_amount`
values are money, in the forecast's stated currency and scale; its
`_ratio` values are dimensionless -- a multiple for the leverage/coverage
family, an explicit ratio for the margin and FCF over debt (N3), each a
share of a whole, never a percentage relabelled without the scaling that
would take, since a Model reader performs no arithmetic on the server's
decimal strings. Closed.
ModelUnit.title: ModelUnit

NarrativeDraft.description:
One span a draft offers: prose, or a reference to a citation the host
resolves -- an anchored one (`figure`) or an unverified one
(`unverified`, D106). Exactly one of the three, and a reference names
only which citation: the rest is the host's to fill from the record.
NarrativeDraft.title: NarrativeDraft

NarrativeFigure.description:
A bracketed figure the narrative cites, self-contained the way
`CitationView` is: the evidence drawer opens it without cross-referencing
`ReportBody.artifacts` for the record or the run's pinned members for the
source. `record_sha256` is the accepted record `route_node_id` bound at
save time; `source_id` is the pinned source `document_sha256` resolves
to, live preferred (N59).
NarrativeFigure.title: NarrativeFigure

NarrativeFigureRef.description:
What a draft may say about a figure: which citation of which node. The
quote and its coordinates are the host's, read from the accepted record.
NarrativeFigureRef.title: NarrativeFigureRef

NarrativeSpan.description: Exactly one of prose, a figure or an unverified figure.
NarrativeSpan.title: NarrativeSpan

NarrativeUnverified.description:
A narrative figure that names an unverified citation (D106, owner:
"Labelled unverified too"): the model's locator, quote and code as the
record holds them, shown labelled unverified with the model's page, and
never opened as a host-verified source.
NarrativeUnverified.title: NarrativeUnverified

NarrativeUnverifiedRef.description:
A draft's figure naming one of a node's unverified citations (D106):
which one, by its place in the record's `unverified` list.
NarrativeUnverifiedRef.title: NarrativeUnverifiedRef

NodeState.description: The bundle's four. RESTRICTED runs; it is not "degraded" or "partial".
NodeState.title: NodeState

NodeView.description: A node's state and the reason for it.
NodeView.title: NodeView

PageBody.description: The text layer of one page of a pinned live source of a run.
PageBody.title: PageBody

PageDocument.description: An evidence page. Not a section document, so it carries no chrome.
PageDocument.title: PageDocument

PageLine.description: One line of the token index: joined text, union rectangle, hidden marks.
PageLine.title: PageLine

QualificationRead.description: A global qualification result; it is not a case section document.
QualificationRead.title: QualificationRead

QualificationState.description: What this caller can truthfully say about one exact evidence identity.
QualificationState.title: QualificationState

RateDeckRateView.description:
One row of a rate deck: a reference rate's Base and Downside rate for
one fiscal year after the last reported (FY+1 is 1). Rates are decimals
in plain notation (0.0380 is 3.80%); the store refuses one outside
(-1, 1) and a second row for the same rate and year.
RateDeckRateView.title: RateDeckRateView

RateDeckRefView.description:
The rate deck the run pinned at its creation, where a projection read
it.
RateDeckRefView.title: RateDeckRefView

RateDeckSaved.description: The receipt for a saved deck.
RateDeckSaved.title: RateDeckSaved

RateDeckView.description:
The latest rate deck, as any signed-in user reads it; the route
answers `null` when none was ever saved.
RateDeckView.title: RateDeckView

RectView.description: A rectangle in page coordinates, from the record.
RectView.title: RectView

RefusalBody.description: Everything a declined request says: the code and what clears it.
RefusalBody.title: RefusalBody

RefusalCode.description: Every reason the host declines. Public-safe by construction.
RefusalCode.title: RefusalCode

RegisterView.description:
One register the module's output profile declares, located by the
bundle's own `_locate_registers` (`find_registers`' body): the header
exactly as written, `declared` the profile column the bundle binds to each
header cell (`None` where it binds none), then every row in header order.
RegisterView.title: RegisterView

ResearchBrief.description:
The caller-authored fields of a run-linked CP-DR brief
(`CP_DR_RESEARCH_BRIEF_V1.md`). The host supplies the rest -- `schema`,
`mode: linked`, the CP-0 `scope_type`/`scope_key`/`subject_name` identity
(from the pinned subject) and `source_mode: supplied_only` (invariant 1)
-- before `bound_research_brief` judges the whole against the pinned
route and subject; this model states only what the vendor schema leaves
to the caller. A route that does not carry CP-DR, or one that requires a
brief this pin omits, still refuses in the store (invariant 4).
ResearchBrief.title: ResearchBrief

ResearchBriefQuestion.description:
One row of a CP-DR brief's bounded question batch
(`CP_DR_RESEARCH_BRIEF_V1.md`'s `questions`).
ResearchBriefQuestion.title: ResearchBriefQuestion

RevisionSummary.description:
One revision of the displayed run and how far it has gone.

What Report lists and Committee's front door links to. It proves nothing:
opening a revision runs that section's own proofs.
RevisionSummary.title: RevisionSummary

RevokeStanding.description: The member is in the path; there is nothing else to say.
RevokeStanding.title: RevokeStanding

RouteChoice.description:
A (profile, selection) pair the adapter executes (`ADAPTER_ROUTES`).

`accepts_model_extension` is the create command's own route resolution
asked in advance: true where the pathway runs every owner CP-CF reads, so
a `CreateRun` asking for the extension would not be refused
`ROUTE_EXTENSION_OWNER_MISSING`. Advisory like every availability the
surface draws -- the command resolves again at commit and is the answer.
RouteChoice.title: RouteChoice

RouteEdgeView.description:
One typed edge of the pinned route, both ends named by module (D73).

Every edge the route carries, met or not. `NodeView.waiting_on` says which
of a node's are still unmet and is a node's reason; this is the route's
shape, so a finished route still reads as the graph it is rather than a
canvas with no line on it (N106).
RouteEdgeView.title: RouteEdgeView

RunBody.description: Latest and displayed run are separate identities (item 1).
RunBody.title: RunBody

RunQualifier.description:
One command qualifier a pin states for one module (D109): CP-2G's
`forecast_horizon`, `base_period` or `cases`, as its `SKILL.md` card
spells them, or CP-0's `objective` (which `PinRunInput.objective` also
carries; stated both ways it is refused). Any other module or name
refuses `RUN_QUALIFIER_INVALID`.
RunQualifier.title: RunQualifier

RunSummary.description: One run of a case, as a list names it.
RunSummary.title: RunSummary

RunView.description: The displayed run. Node states are recomputed, never stored.
RunView.title: RunView

SaveRateDeck.description:
A global ADMIN's new rate deck. The saver is the actor, never a field;
the store refuses an empty deck (the browser's schema has no minimum).
SaveRateDeck.title: SaveRateDeck

SaveRevision.description:
A draft over one run's accepted artifacts.

`expected_revision_id` is the latest revision of that run the client had
when it composed this draft, null when it saw none: a save that raced
another save is refused rather than quietly making a second head.
SaveRevision.title: SaveRevision

SectionNote.description: Why a section document is partial or empty. Closed.
SectionNote.title: SectionNote

ServedRole.description: Who the server answered as. Shown, and enables nothing (decision 5).
ServedRole.title: ServedRole

SignOpinion.description: Invariant 5: the signature binds the exact bytes the signer reviewed.
SignOpinion.title: SignOpinion

SignVerdict.description:
A reviewer's verdict document: the seven bindings `read_verdict`
declares, and nothing else. The shape is closed here; what the document
*means* -- a naive or future `decided_at`, a passed expiry -- is the
reader's to decide, so the moments travel as text and are parsed once,
there. The reviewer's identity is not a field: the host derives it from
the actor. `evidence_sha256` names the exact evidence identity the
document was read against (N44): the other six can agree for two
different snapshots of the same set, build and provider.
SignVerdict.title: SignVerdict

SourceRow.description: One admitted source; withdrawal is read live.
SourceRow.title: SourceRow

Standing.description: What a member may do on one case, least to most.
Standing.title: Standing

Subject.description: The case the section is about.
Subject.title: Subject

TableView.description:
One `<!-- table-id: -->`-tagged table, as the bundle's reader reads it:
the header, then every row in header order.
TableView.title: TableView

UnverifiedCitationView.description:
A citation of an accepted answer that did not anchor (D106): the
model's own `source_id`, page and quote, as recorded, and the code that
left it unverified. Never host-verified and never re-anchored: it has no
line, no rectangle and no document the host located, and its claim is
Deploy V's lineage class "Untraced". `source_id` is the model's, which
may name no source this run was given (`CITATION_NOT_DELIVERED`).
UnverifiedCitationView.title: UnverifiedCitationView

VerdictRecorded.description:
The receipt for a recorded verdict: which evidence, who the host bound
it to, and the currency the reviewer declared.
VerdictRecorded.title: VerdictRecorded

WithdrawBookEntry.description:
Withdraw an entry, never delete it (spec B7): bound to the entry's
snapshot digest, with a reason, and a note that `OTHER` requires.
WithdrawBookEntry.title: WithdrawBookEntry

WithdrawSource.description: Invariant 1's second half. The source is in the path.
WithdrawSource.title: WithdrawSource

WorkView.description: The run's `run_work` row, when it has been enqueued.
WorkView.title: WorkView
